tasks.description: Thursday 8am CT pre-flight check for all Lexington Gays event sources. Tests URL reachability, flags dead sources, and cross-references last week's events to catch silent failures.
Wednesday 9am: Write and publish a weekly SEO blog post on LexingtonGays.com, then submit to Google Search Console for indexing.
Wednesday 3pm CT: Mid-week social post to Facebook + Instagram keeping the page warm between Monday and Saturday. Highlights Thu-Sun events from Monday's scrape.
Wednesday 7pm CT: Send (or draft) weekly Lexington Gays email newsletter with top events, a business spotlight, and a community note. Builds owned email audience.
Saturday 9am CT: Post "This Weekend in Lexington" highlight to Facebook + Instagram using Monday's already-scraped event data. No new scrape needed.
1st Wednesday of each month, 8am CT: Pull GA4 traffic report for lexingtongays.com and write monthly growth summary to pending-william-actions.md.
2nd Tuesday of each month, 10am CT: Submit lexingtongays.com to LGBTQ+ travel directories, local event aggregators, and community resource sites for backlinks and referral traffic.

3rd Tuesday of each month, 10am CT: Research and draft outreach to 3 Lexington LGBTQ+ organizations for cross-promotion, mutual linking, and community partnerships. Drafts go to pending-william-actions.md for William's review.
Daily 9:32am -- process new Lexington Gays event form submissions from Gmail and publish to site

instructions: For each task in `tasks`, the build-city skill orchestrator must call mcp__scheduled-tasks__create_scheduled_task with the corresponding taskId, cronExpression, description, and the SKILL.md content as `prompt`. Without this step the SKILL.md files sit on disk and NEVER fire. See PROCESS-FIX 12 in install_scheduled_tasks.py.
